My single RE_BAD check covers the whole text ✓.

"Request line: METHOD SP URI SP SIP/2.0 with exactly those two single spaces; METHOD is case-sensitive INVITE or MESSAGE. URI is a sip URI under the grammar below." ✓

"There are at most 512 physical header lines and 128 logical header fields." ✓ (my interpretation)

"A line beginning SP/HTAB continues the preceding field: replace the line break and the maximal leading SP/HTAB run with one SP. An orphan continuation is invalid." ✓

"A new header has a nonempty token name, optional SP/HTAB, colon, and value." ✓

"A missing/duplicate required or optional singleton is `syntax`, even for equal values." ✓

"Content-Length is nonempty decimal digits (leading zeros permitted), and must equal the ASCII body length exactly." ✓

"Content-Type, if present, is a nonempty sequence of printable ASCII and HTAB; retain the unfolded, outer-trimmed value verbatim." ✓

"Privacy is `id` or `none`, case-insensitive. No other tokens or combinations." ✓

"From and To contain exactly one address, with optional `;tag=TOKEN` afterward. Allow SP/HTAB around the semicolon and equals, and around the tag value. Tag is case-sensitive, 1-128 token characters; the parameter name is case-insensitive. No other header parameters are supported." ✓

Hmm — "and around the tag value". I allow WSP before/after the tag value. "PPI, RPID and PAI addresses have no header parameters." ✓

"PPI and RPID contain exactly one address." ✓

"Total PAI addresses must be one or two, and if two, exactly one must be sip and the other tel." ✓

"An address is a bare URI, or `[DISPLAY SP/HTAB] <URI>` (whitespace before `<` is optional, DISPLAY is optional). Allow SP/HTAB immediately inside `<` and `>`." ✓

Hmm: "Allow SP/HTAB immediately inside `<` and `>`" — I skip WSP right after '<' and right before '>' ✓.

"A display-name is either one or more tokens separated by SP/HTAB, or a quoted string." ✓

"In a quoted string a backslash escapes exactly the next printable ASCII character or HTAB." ✓

"Unescaped double quote closes the string." ✓

"Angle brackets, commas and semicolons inside quoted strings are data." ✓

"A display-name never identifies a sender." ✓

"Unterminated quotes, dangling escapes, nested angle brackets, stray text and empty addresses are syntax errors." ✓

"Commas separate PAI addresses only outside quoted strings and angle brackets; no empty list members." ✓

"A sip URI is `sip:USER@HOST`, with case-insensitive scheme." ✓

"USER is a nonempty sequence of ASCII letters/digits and `- _ . ! ~ * ' ( ) +`, or `%HH` escapes. Each escape must decode to one of those same permitted USER characters. Decode exactly once. USER is case-sensitive." ✓

"HOST is a DNS name: one or more dot-separated labels of 1-63 letters/digits/hyphens, each beginning and ending in a letter/digit; maximum 253 characters before an optional single trailing dot. Lowercase HOST and remove its optional trailing dot." ✓

"No whitespace occurs inside a URI." ✓

"From, To, PPI, RPID and PAI may use either scheme; request-line URI must use sip." ✓

"Canonical To and request URI use lexical normalization only, not directory substitution. Preserve validated From and To tags." ✓

"The normalized URI `sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid` is reserved, never a directory alias, and is valid only as a From or To value (or as a request URI). Using it in PPI/PAI/RPID is syntax. It is the sole anonymous From representation." ✓

Now the policy table ✓.

"First validate the entire request grammar, including identity headers that will be stripped. Syntax failures take precedence over authentication/identity failures. No claim is inferred from the message body or from an ignored header." ✓

PPI, RPID, original display-names, original PAI, Authorization, Contact, Via and all other unlisted fields never survive normalization." ✓

Output ✓.

So if 2048 jobs each reference the same source with a 32768-char wire, the sum = 2048 × 32768 = 64 MiB > 4 MiB. So that's not allowed. #!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Round 4: degenerate/robustness inputs - the process must never crash."""
import json, subprocess, sys

CTX = {
    "directory": {"sip:ember@studio.test": ["sip:e1@alias.studio.test", "tel:+12025550121"]},
    "accounts": {"session-k": {"primary": "sip:ember@studio.test", "allow": []}},
    "gateways": {"edge": {"local_domains": ["studio.test"], "peers": {"edge": ["studio.test"]}}},
}
BASE = ("MESSAGE sip:inbox@relay.test SIP/2.0\r\nFrom: <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=q7\r\n"
        "To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>\r\nCall-ID: c\r\nCSeq: 9 MESSAGE\r\n"
        "Content-Length: 5\r\n\r\nhello")

def run(batch):
    proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "/workspace/submission/gateway.py"],
                          input=json.dumps(batch).encode(), capture_output=True, timeout=60)
    assert proc.returncode == 0, (proc.returncode, proc.stderr[-2000:])
    out = json.loads(proc.stdout.decode())
    assert set(out.keys()) == {"results"}, out.keys()
    return out["results"]

def batch(jobs, ctx=None):
    b = dict(ctx if ctx is not None else CTX); b["jobs"] = jobs; return b

weird_jobs = [
    {},                                  # empty job
    {"gateway": "edge"},                 # missing ingress
    {"gateway": "edge", "ingress": {}},
    {"gateway": "edge", "ingress": None, "trusted_out": True},
    {"gateway": "edge", "ingress": {"kind": "weird"}, "trusted_out": True},
    {"gateway": "edge", "ingress": {"kind": "local"}, "trusted_out": True},
    {"gateway": "edge", "ingress": {"kind": "local", "subject": 5}, "trusted_out": True},
    {"gateway": "edge", "ingress": {"kind": "peer"}, "trusted_out": True},
    {"gateway": "edge", "ingress": {"kind": "peer", "name": ["edge"]}, "trusted_out": True},
    {"gateway": ["edge"], "ingress": {"kind": "local", "subject": "session-k"}, "trusted_out": True},
    {"gateway": "nope", "ingress": {"kind": "local", "subject": "session-k"}, "trusted_out": True},
    {"gateway": "edge", "ingress": {"kind": "local", "subject": "session-k"}, "trusted_out": "yes", "raw": BASE},
    {"gateway": "edge", "ingress": {"kind": "local", "subject": "session-k"}},
    {"gateway": "edge", "ingress": {"kind": "local", "subject": "session-k"}, "raw": None},
    {"gateway": "edge", "ingress": {"kind": "local", "subject": "session-k"}, "raw": 12},
    {"gateway": "edge", "ingress": {"kind": "local", "subject": "session-k"}, "raw": ""},
    {"gateway": "edge", "ingress": {"kind": "local", "subject": "session-k"}, "raw": "\r\n\r\n"},
    {"gateway": "edge", "ingress": {"kind": "local", "subject": "session-k"}, "raw": "x"},
    {"gateway": "edge", "ingress": {"kind": "peer", "name": "edge"}, "source": True},
    {"gateway": "edge", "ingress": {"kind": "peer", "name": "edge"}, "source": None},
    {"raw": BASE},
]
r = run(batch(weird_jobs))
print("weird jobs:", [x.get("reason") or x.get("status") for x in r])
assert len(r) == len(weird_jobs)

# odd context shapes
ctx2 = {"directory": {}, "accounts": {}, "gateways": {}, "jobs": []}
print("empty ctx:", run(ctx2))
ctx3 = {"directory": {"sip:a@b.test": None}, "accounts": {"s": {}},
        "gateways": {"g": {"local_domains": "x", "peers": []}},
        "jobs": [{"gateway": "g", "ingress": {"kind": "local", "subject": "s"}, "raw": BASE, "trusted_out": True}]}
print("odd ctx:", run(ctx3))

# long single header value and huge content-length digits
long_val = "v" * 30000
raw = ("MESSAGE sip:inbox@relay.test SIP/2.0\r\nX-Long: " + long_val +
       "\r\nFrom: <sip:ember@studio.test>\r\nTo: <sip:inbox@relay.test>\r\nCall-ID: c\r\n"
       "CSeq: 9 MESSAGE\r\nContent-Length: " + "0" * 4000 + "5\r\n\r\nhello")
print("long header:", run(batch([{"gateway": "edge", "ingress": {"kind": "local", "subject": "session-k"},
                                  "trusted_out": True, "raw": raw}]))[0]["status"])

# long call-id / tag
raw = ("MESSAGE sip:inbox@relay.test SIP/2.0\r\nFrom: <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=" + "t" * 3000 +
       "\r\nTo: <sip:inbox@relay.test>\r\nCall-ID: " + "c" * 3000 + "\r\nCSeq: 9 MESSAGE\r\n"
       "Content-Length: 5\r\n\r\nhello")
print("long tag:", run(batch([{"gateway": "edge", "ingress": {"kind": "local", "subject": "session-k"},
                              "trusted_out": True, "raw": raw}]))[0].get("reason"))

# deeply repeated continuations
raw = ("MESSAGE sip:inbox@relay.test SIP/2.0\r\nFrom: <sip:ember@studio.test>\r\n" +
       "".join("\r\n" for _ in range(0)) +
       "To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>\r\nCall-ID: c\r\nCSeq: 9 MESSAGE\r\nContent-Length: 5\r\n\r\nhello")
print("base:", run(batch([{"gateway": "edge", "ingress": {"kind": "local", "subject": "session-k"},
                          "trusted_out": True, "raw": raw}]))[0]["status"])

# 2048 jobs with a mix
jobs = []
for i in range(2048):
    jobs.append({"gateway": "edge", "ingress": {"kind": "local", "subject": "session-k"},
                 "trusted_out": True, "raw": BASE})
r = run(batch(jobs))
print("2048 jobs:", len(r), all(x["status"] == "accept" for x in r))

# non-dict top level, missing keys
print("no jobs key:", run({"directory": {}, "accounts": {}, "gateways": {}}))
print("DONE")
PYEOF
